name: Fintech & payments
title:
Payments that clear.
Books that balance.
sub: Embedded payments, wallets, KYC and the reporting finance teams trust: built under PCI-DSS, measured by conversion and settlement rather than by features.

facts.label: merchants, four months after launch
transactions in the same four months
compliance built in from day one
document verification, automated

asks: PCI-DSS and KYC
Scope the cardholder-data boundary first and keep it small. Automate the document checks so onboarding never waits on a review queue.
Fraud and reconciliation
Anomaly detection across payments and balances, and a ledger that reconciles to the processor every day rather than at month end.
Conversion as the metric
Checkout and onboarding conversion measured from week one. Payment-method mix decides what gets built next.
services: The platform itself: onboarding, wallets, billing, in your cloud account.
Fraud and anomaly detection with an evaluation gate, not a rule that nobody dares change.
Reconciliation and finance reporting that matches the processor.
Load tested before the campaign, not during it.
close: Tell us what has to clear. We will say how we would build it.

name: Retail & e-commerce
title:
Checkouts that convert.
Stock that is where it says.
sub: Storefronts, loyalty, personalisation, inventory and POS: for retailers from one store to a hundred, measured by repeat purchase and conversion.

facts.label: repeat transactions, enterprise loyalty
client ROI from personalisation, upper bound
cloud POS locations
more repeat customers in two months

asks: Peak load
Loyalty and checkout on microservices with caching for the Friday night that matters, load-tested before the campaign.
Inventory truth
One stock position across stores, warehouses and the app, with the reconciliation jobs that keep it true.
Repeat purchase
Loyalty rules with fraud risk designed in, personalisation with evaluation gates, and a funnel instrumented so every change is proven rather than asserted.
services: Storefront, loyalty engine, POS: built to a scope, in your cloud.
Funnel instrumentation and the warehouse behind the dashboards.
Recommendation and image search with evaluation before release.
The quick-commerce app, store-ready, with offline tolerance.
close: Bring the funnel. We will say where it leaks.

name: Healthcare & life sciences
title:
Software a regulator
will sign off.
sub: Insurance platforms, telemedicine, surgical imaging, preclinical research data and care-home IoT: built to be supervised, audited and still used.

facts.label: less analysis time on preclinical data
handling of patient data and imaging
insurance platform launched under regulation
IoT alerting proven in real care settings before scaling

asks: Regulatory sign-off
Map the underwriting, claims or clinical workflow before designing against it. Keep a document a supervisor can read beside the product a member can use.
Patient data
Role-based access, HIPAA-grade handling, imaging on object storage with audit trails. Nothing leaves the account it lives in.
Trust in the alert
Validate in real care settings before scaling. A model's output has to earn a clinician's trust, so precision is measured before rollout.
services: The member, patient or clinician journey, from discovery to launch.
Imaging analysis and alerting with the evaluation to defend it.
Harmonised research data and the dashboards over it.
Test coverage a regulator can read.
close: Tell us who has to sign it off. We will design for them.

name: Logistics, travel & marketplaces
title:
Real-time, on the road,
on a bad connection.
sub: Dispatch boards, driver apps, vehicle marketplaces and travel products: three kinds of user sharing one system, and the data that keeps them honest.

facts.label: load status and assignments over WebSockets
transporter, driver and customer in one app
growth in qualified inbound leads, six months, audited
rental, flights and community in one product

asks: Live state
WebSockets for status and assignment, live tracking on the map, and revenue and broker analytics from the same stream.
Drivers in motion
Large targets, quick actions, offline tolerance. The interface is designed for a hand on the wheel, not a desk.
Demand
Intent-based landing pages and listing schema so the marketplace fills without buying every lead.
services: The dispatch board and the admin behind it.
The driver and customer app, offline-tolerant, store-ready.
Route, revenue and broker analytics from live data.
The infrastructure that keeps real-time real at peak.
close: Tell us what moves. We will keep the screen honest about where it is.

name: IoT, signage & the built environment
title:
Devices that keep working
when the network does not.
sub: Digital signage platforms, device telemetry and building intelligence: offline-first players, fleet sync, public APIs and dashboards for the people who run the estate.

facts.label: buildings on one telemetry platform
signage platform in production
device sync over MQTT
device telemetry open to partners

asks: Offline-first
Players and sensors that lose the network for a week keep working and reconcile when they return. Sync over MQTT, not polling.
Fleet at scale
Multi-tenant backends, partner integrations with the display makers, and infrastructure that stays up under sustained memory pressure.
Telemetry people act on
Real-time operational data rather than last month's report, and APIs partners can build on, with versioning and documentation.
services: The platform: tenants, CMS, players, partner integrations.
The fleet's infrastructure, stabilised and observable.
Custom Android players and the apps that control them.
Telemetry pipelines and the dashboards the estate team opens.
close: Tell us what the devices must do when the network is down.

name: SaaS, platforms & AI products
title:
Products that ship
and keep shipping.
sub: Multi-tenant SaaS, enterprise platforms, developer APIs and AI products: built with an agentic pipeline and the evaluation discipline to keep them right.

facts.label: engineers on the agentic delivery path
detection accuracy, computer-vision product
SaaS with a white-label reseller tier
critical milestone shipped on deadline

asks: Multi-tenancy
Tenants, white-label tiers and credit-based monetisation designed in from the schema up, not bolted on when the second customer arrives.
Integrations
Dynamics, Dataverse, SharePoint, Power BI, Xero: the plumbing is most of the product, so it is reviewed like the product.
AI that stays right
Evaluation gates before release, monitoring after, small models where a large one is too expensive. The harness decides.
services: The product, scoped and shipped in six-week increments.
Model features, agents and retrieval with a number to defend.
Senior engineers inside your team when the roadmap outgrows it.
Generated tests and guardrails on every change.
